text:
Erin: Quick non-work question — if you had to pick ONLY two non-essential things to keep from your home (not counting phone/wallet/keys), what would they be? Asking for a fictional apocalypse curate. :thinking_face:
Devon: Espresso machine + turntable. can't imagine mornings without that combo. ☕🎶
Peter: Bike and ramen cooker. one keeps me sane, one keeps me fed and sad but warm.
Natalie: My succulents + duvet. plants = vibes, duvet = survival blanket. :seedling::blanket:
Erin: @natalie how do you fit 27 succulents in a one-bed? :laughing:
Natalie: Shelf fortress. also, counting comfort items = valid life choices.
Devon: Also leaning headphones + a hardcover notebook. noise cancellation is a personality.
Peter: Are pets allowed? because if so my dog walks away with this. :pleading_face:
Erin: Pets excluded for fairness, but emotionally I agree. cats would win.
ops-bot: heads-up: built-in polls are disabled here — use emoji reactions to vote.
Devon: OK poll format: react with :one: for espresso+turntable, :two: bike+ramen, :three: plants+duvet, :four: headphones+notebook, :five: pet (illegal but symbolic).
Erin: adding reactions now :point_down:
Peter: :two:
Natalie: :three:
Devon: :one:
Erin: :five: (for the vibe) :laughing:
Devon: This is why the watercooler exists. Also, who wants to do "favorite indie coffee shop" next? :raised_hands:
Natalie: me — i'll drop a map thread later with recs.
Erin: Love it, thanks y'all. heartwarming variety as always. :heart:
